ideas.name: Septic Air Force

backstory.text: The Septic Air Force earned its name when a maintenance crew found a swarm circling a blocked vent with the persistence of aircraft waiting for landing clearance. They have since been spotted throughout the sewers, flying in close formation toward no particular destination. Their buzzing carries impressively far for something with so little to report. Plumbers and monsters alike suffer for wandering into their flight path. Nobody has identified a commanding officer, although several flies appear to be taking credit.
backstory.canon_note: Name selected by Sean; revised history is a Storyboarding draft. Aviation language is comic metaphor, not military equipment or new attack behavior. No plot spoilers.
